description: Source code for the AudioRendererPassthrough class, implementing audio passthrough functionality for Android in the starboard namespace, including handling of audio decoding, buffer management, and thread synchronization.

classes.name: AudioRendererPassthrough
classes.description: Class implementing audio passthrough rendering, decoding, buffer management, and thread handling for Android.
